# quota-pacer v1.0.17

## 更新内容

### 中文

- 修复与增强 Codex 配额解析：新增对 `business` 与 `self_serve_business_prolite` 订阅计划类型的识别，将其映射为付费 Team 级别的周度配额，确保企业/商业版凭据的配额与重置时间能够被正常解析与配速调度。
- 文档与测试术语统一：清理 Codex 重置额度测试和应用层用例中残留的过时概念，全面统一至 raw / uplift / normalized headroom 术语体系。

### English

- Fix & enhance Codex quota parsing: added recognition for `business` and `self_serve_business_prolite` subscription plan types, mapping them to paid Team-level weekly quotas to ensure enterprise/business credentials have their remaining quotas and reset windows parsed and paced accurately.
- Documentation & test terminology cleanup: updated tests and comments to consistently use the raw / uplift / normalized headroom terminology introduced in the global uplift refactor, removing references to obsolete functions and descriptions.
